judgment_calls: The voice section (n001-n002) is brief with no examples, unlike the other two sections. Included it as complete nodes because it is a full guideline section with heading metadata and a substantive rule; omitting it would leave non-blank lines uncovered.

Combined the preset-voice requirement and modulation allowance in n002 as one coherent claim rather than splitting them; the allowance ('may still change...within natural range') is a clarifying exception to the core requirement, not an independent assertion.

Made n008 and n015 provide named concepts (openness_to_discussing_differences, autonomy_support_principle) to serve as semantic bridges between their parent principles and the example nodes that demonstrate them; this mirrors the worked example pattern of principle→guidance→example.

Did not split L1983 beyond its two natural sentences; while both emanate from fairness_principle, they establish two distinct practices (non-discrimination vs. consistency) and are best represented as separate nodes with separate needs/provides relationships.

Included all inherited seeds in needs entries exactly as provided in division.json, preserving prose unchanged per phase rules. Two inherited seeds (authority_levels_hierarchy, scope_of_autonomy) remain dangling needs—correctly so, as they are established outside this span.
